entries.name: Shotover Jet

facts.claim: Individual pass: Adult $199, Child $109; family pass $507 (2 adults + 2 children). Prices valid to 30 Sep 2027. Opening hours 9am-5pm, first/last trip 9:30am / 4pm, trip length 25 min, check-in 30 min prior, departures every 30 min.
FAQ: adventure lasts about 25 minutes; operates every day of the year (weather permitting) except Christmas Day; the only company permitted in the Shotover canyons.

entries.ticketUrl_note: Loaded; title 'Best Jet Boat Ride in Queenstown | Shotover Jet'. Operator's own site.
entries.suggested_bio: A high-speed jet boat that spins and skims past the rock walls of the narrow Shotover River canyons.
unverified: Existing spot has costMin/Max 159 and hours 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM: both are out of date (now $199 and 9-5).

entries.name: Dunedin Prison

facts.claim: Operator (Dunedin Prison Charitable Trust, site titled 'Dunedin GAOL History Unlocked'): opened 1898, closed as a Corrections facility 2007; tours 10.30am Saturday and Sunday (home page) or Saturday in summer (guided-tours page), 1 hour, Adult $15, Child $5, payable on the day.
Wikivoyage Dunedin lists Dunedin Prison with the Trust's site; OSM 'Former Dunedin Police Station & Prison' relation 6 m from the placement point.

unverified: Tour days conflict on the operator's own pages (Sat+Sun vs Saturday in summer): the placement bio 'set weekend times' is too specific; use the suggested bio.
The operator calls it 'Dunedin Gaol'; Wikipedia/Wikivoyage 'Dunedin Prison' (keep the placement name).

entries.name: Macetown

facts.claim: DOC Macetown Historic Reserve: 15 km from Arrowtown; 4WD about 1 hr each way, walking 3-4 hr each way, mountain biking 1-2 hr each way; restored Andersons Battery, Needhams Cottage, Smiths Bakehouse; vehicle access under a locked gate with a fee-based online-permit system.
NZFWDA managed access system (operational from 1 April 2026): standard 4WD or off-road motorcycle permit $40 per trip. Walkers and cyclists pass the gate without a permit (DOC page).
OSM place=locality node 'Macetown'.

entries.ticketUrl_note: Loaded; title 'Macetown Historic Reserve: Places to go in Otago'. DOC is the managing agency.

coordinates_check.source: OSM place=locality node 1988523178 (the townsite; reached on foot/4WD from the Arrowtown end of Macetown Road)

entries.suggested_bio: The restored ruins of a gold-mining town in the Arrow valley, reached by a 4WD road, bike or long walk from Arrowtown.
unverified: free: true is for walkers and cyclists; driving needs a $40 NZFWDA permit (search snippet; confirm). Treat as 'free to walk, permit to drive'.
Suggested bio mentions the 4WD road and walk; DOC says the drive crosses the Arrow River 23 times and is risky.

entries.name: Tunnel Hill
entries.recommend: CONFLICT RESOLVED FOR KEEP: two counted sources name Tunnel Hill (DOC's own visitor page and Wikivoyage The Catlins 'See' listing), which meets the 'marginal needs two independent counted sources' bar. It is a 15-min walk to a distinct draw (DOC calls it the world's southernmost railway tunnel), so keep in Catlins (Otago) and let region-southland drop its review entry.

facts.claim: DOC Historic Railway Tunnel Walk: 15 min return; carpark and track entrance on SH92 (Southern Scenic Route), 5 km north of Owaka; 250 m tunnel from the Catlins River Branch railway, built 1890s.
Wikivoyage The Catlins 'See': 'Walk through a 250 m disused brick-lined railway tunnel that was dug by hand in the 1890s. It is now an historic reserve. Taking a torch is recommended.'
OSM highway=path 'Tunnel Hill Track' at the placement point.

entries.ticketUrl_note: Loaded; title 'Historic Railway Tunnel Walk'. DOC is the managing agency.

Wikivoyage The Catlins 'See' lists Waipohatu Forest Walks: a 1 km wheelchair-standard walk and a 3-hour walk to two hidden waterfalls.

entries.name: Roxburgh Gorge Trail

Great Rides (nzcycletrail.com): Roxburgh Gorge Trail Great Ride, grade 2-3, jet boat tour through remote reaches.
ODT (older, date not confirmed): the boat transfer was priced at $95 per person by both operators.
